title: Trending and new concepts from References and topics
description: The snapshot already ranks entities by surprise, marks new ones and tracks topic clusters as growing or cooling, but only over published Items, so a site with few Stories shows little. Extend the same rules to accepted References, kept as a separate series from Stories. Use the source's publication date where known and the arrival date otherwise, and say which (`docs/idea-context-packs.md` section 2.3). Trending from entities and growth from topic clusters stay separate views, linked where a cluster's top terms match a concept.
